This directory contains the unmodified `packages/local/src` files from [OpenAI Sign in with ChatGPT DevKit, revision 0a36fef](https://github.com/openai/sign-in-with-chatgpt-devkit/tree/0a36fefeb913055c8c7a1a29b63d82b96b2e841a). OpenAI’s Noncommercial License and third-party notices are reproduced alongside the source. The application accesses this library through its public interface. The build bundles it into `runtime/host.cjs`.
